instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure exact multi-page routing with React Router v7 across Home (/), About (/about), Observances (/observances), Membership (/membership), Shop (/shop), and Contact (/contact).
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all key buttons, inputs, navigation links, cards, and modal triggers.
Include an interactive functional cart drawer state saved to React state / localStorage for the Shop page.
Use Lucide-react or Radix icons for clean visual indicators.
Form submit handlers should send POST payload to FastAPI backend (/api/register and /api/contact) and display a clear success Sonner toast notification.
Strictly follow high-contrast WCAG rules using Deep Navy (#0A192F), Crisp White (#FFFFFF), Warm Amber (#D97706), and Slate Gray (#475569).
Hero section must include an SVG/Canvas official emblem logo with deep navy and amber accents, motto 'Coniuncti ad futurum', and kinetic entrance effect.
No deity figures, altars, or denomination symbols. All images must feature diverse people collaborating, sharing meals, or quiet natural landscapes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark gradients over dark text. Maintain maximum text legibility.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use asymmetric editorial bento grids and layered typography.
Ensure every interactive element has explicit hover/active states.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8 minimum).
Include data-testid on all interactive elements in kebab-case format.
